item.name: Freelancer views bookings on their gigs -> 200

exec: pm.test('No bookings leak to other clients', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.have.length(0));
pm.test('Refund transaction reverses the payment', () => { pm.expect(refund.type).to.eql('refund'); pm.expect(refund.amount).to.eql(-1000); });
pm.test('Three records for this client', () => pm.expect(tx).to.have.length(3));
pm.test('All belong to the client', () => tx.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.client.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('clientId'))));

item.name: Freelancer income summary -> net of refund

exec: pm.test('Gross R1000 after one refund', () => pm.expect(s.grossIncome).to.eql(1000));
pm.test('Net R900 after 10% platform fee', () => pm.expect(s.netIncome).to.eql(900));
pm.test('Booking counts tracked', () => pm.expect(s.bookings).to.eql({ confirmed: 0, completed: 1, cancelled: 1 }));
pm.test('Income is attributed to the correct freelancer only', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.netIncome).to.eql(0));
pm.test('No password hashes in response', () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(u => pm.expect(u.password).to.be.undefined));
pm.test('Stats include bookings and revenue', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.bookings).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('platformRevenue'); });

item.name: 7. Tax estimate (Part 3)
item.description: SARS income tax estimate on the freelancer's own net earnings for the current tax year.

exec: pm.test('Uses net earnings this tax year (R900 after the refund)', () => pm.expect(t.ytdIncome).to.eql(900));
pm.test('Gross and platform fee for the year', () => { pm.expect(t.ytdGross).to.eql(1000); pm.expect(t.ytdPlatformFees).to.eql(100); });
pm.test('Twelve months in the tax year', () => pm.expect(t.months).to.have.length(12));
pm.test('Below the threshold -> no tax', () => { pm.expect(t.belowThreshold).to.eql(true); pm.expect(t.estimatedAnnualTax).to.eql(0); });

8. Part 3 security features
item.description: Account lockout, logout (token revocation), admin session revocation, security monitor, prototype-pollution stripping and request ids. Runs last because it revokes tokens used earlier.

item.name: Wrong password until the account locks (4 x 401, then 423)

exec: pm.test('5th failure locks the account: 423', () => pm.response.to.have.status(423));

pm.test('Lockout message and Retry-After header', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.match(/try again in 15 minutes/); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Retry-After')).to.eql('900'); });

item.name: Correct password while locked -> still 423 (no token)

exec: pm.test('Session ended message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Your session has ended. Please log in again.'));

item.name: Admin revokes all sessions of the second client -> 200

exec: pm.test('Handled as a normal failed login (401), not a 500', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
